card.name: Odd spacing characters in dose text
card.fires_on: Invisible or odd spacing characters and split-up word pieces, often right before the superscript 2 in mg/m² dose units. Also fires inside letter-spaced drug names in dosing tables.

modes.label: Hidden space before m²
modes.description: A blank or special space character sitting between 'm' and the superscript 2 in a per-body-area dose.

modes.label: Broken-up drug or table words
modes.description: A single letter or short piece inside a drug name or heading that has been split by spacing in a dosage table.

card.writes: It seems to push toward rare special space and quote characters, which hints at messy text formatting.
card.plain: It marks places where the label text has stray hidden spaces or letters pulled apart, especially in doses per square meter.
